title: Creating a Game Character, rigging it and animating it using Codex on a Blender Fork
author: Pradyumgg
selftext:
Built a game character end to end using Codex on a Blender fork. Generation, rigging, and the walk animation were all done in one shot with fairly minimal prompts.

Didn't expect it to hold up as well as it did with that little direction. Posting it as a showcase more than anything.

Happy to answer questions about the setup.

replies.author: Pradyumgg
replies.body:
The base of the application in itself is free/open source. 

To use the agent you can plug in SOTA api keys, Open router or your own codex sub.

That being said, our agent harness performs the best using Mixar credits, since that allows different models to be assigned for each subagent dedicatedly. And new users do get 1000 credits for free.

Local models aren't supported yet but we are working on that. Meanwhile you can connect several models via open router
